_about: The line under a name in the footer carousels. It must always be a role — what
this person does — and never a fallback like 'In the archive 2012-2014'.
Nothing here is invented. Every entry carries its source:
archive             the `affiliation` field on si_person, verbatim except for a
trailing full stop or a trailing clause that would not fit
on one line. `raw` records what was cut.
profile build already fills from public record
archive-translated  the archive's OWN affiliation, in French, rendered into
English using the organisation's official English name.
`raw` is the French the archive holds.
Anyone without an entry here is not in the cast. That is deliberate: the build
fails rather than printing a person with no title, so the rule cannot rot.
Only 44 of the 132 people with a licensed portrait have a usable title at all,
and only 32 of those also have a face the cascade found. That is the real
constraint on the cast, and it is a content backlog, not a design choice:
see people/README.md on affiliation rows holding transcript text.
